# Fraction ERP

> Cloud ERP software for small to medium-sized precision engineering, manufacturing, fabrication, and assembly companies. Fraction ERP helps businesses move from spreadsheets to a fully operational ERP system, covering sales, purchasing, inventory, production scheduling, shop floor data capture, quality, shipping, and invoicing.

Fraction ERP is designed for manufacturing SMEs that have outgrown spreadsheets but do not need the overhead of an enterprise ERP project. It provides serious manufacturing capability through workflows that are straightforward to understand, learn, implement, and operate.

Fraction ERP is continuously developed through two sources of current information: feedback from Fraction customers and daily use inside a real precision engineering business. Fraction's Product Manager also runs that manufacturing business, so product decisions are informed by current operational experience rather than assumptions about how a factory should work.

For a fuller AI-readable product brief, see [llms-full.txt](https://fractionerp.com/llms-full.txt).

## Short Answer

Fraction ERP is a cloud-based manufacturing ERP and MRP system for SMEs that need to control sales orders, BOMs, works orders, purchasing, inventory, scheduling, shop floor progress, quality, shipping and invoicing in one web application. It is positioned as a practical alternative to spreadsheets and over-complex enterprise ERP projects, with per-user pricing, unlimited shop floor data capture users, and implementation support focused on going live quickly.

## Product / Feature Pages

- [Manufacturing ERP Software](https://fractionerp.com/mrp-software/): Core MRP and manufacturing ERP capabilities
- [Simple ERP System](https://fractionerp.com/simple-erp-system/): Simple manufacturing ERP positioning for SME manufacturers that need practical workflows without enterprise complexity
- [Production Scheduling Software](https://fractionerp.com/production-scheduling-software/): Drag-and-drop scheduling with workcentre and operator capacity
- [Shop Floor Data Capture](https://fractionerp.com/shopfloor-data-capture-software/): Real-time tracking of production on the shop floor
- [Bill of Materials Software](https://fractionerp.com/bill-of-materials-software/): BOM creation, templating, and version management
- [Health and Safety Software](https://fractionerp.com/health-safety-software/): Health and safety records inside manufacturing ERP, starting with workplace risk assessments
- [Risk Assessment Software](https://fractionerp.com/risk-assessment-software/): Workplace risk assessments for manufacturers, with COSHH register support planned
- [Visitor Registration](https://fractionerp.com/visitor-kiosk/): Account-free tablet or desktop visitor sign-in with custom declarations, badge printing, clock-out, live dashboard visibility and host arrival emails
- [Sales Order Management](https://fractionerp.com/sales-order-management-software/): Quote-to-invoice workflow
- [Purchasing and Inventory](https://fractionerp.com/purchasing-inventory-software/): Purchase orders, stock control, reorder points
- [Cloud ERP Software](https://fractionerp.com/cloud-erp-software/): Cloud deployment and mobility
- [Mobile ERP App](https://fractionerp.com/mobile-erp/): iOS and Android app for live inventory checks, shop floor logging, SOPs, production status and ERP task management; an active connection is required
- [Time and Attendance](https://fractionerp.com/time-and-attendance/): Add-on for any Fraction ERP subscription plan at £3 per user per month with all Time and Attendance features included; covers leave rules and approvals, mobile and kiosk clocking, geofencing, shift and overtime tracking, Bradford Factor scores, not-in-yet alerts, SFDC closure checks and live staff availability in production scheduling
- [AI in ERP and the Intelligence Centre](https://fractionerp.com/ai-in-erp/): Pro-plan rules-based manufacturing intelligence that ranks profitability, cost, operation, purchasing, delivery, people and data-quality exceptions; it is not a generative AI agent and links every finding back to ERP evidence for human review
- [CRM](https://fractionerp.com/crm/): Customer relationship management within ERP
- [Integrations](https://fractionerp.com/integrations/): Accounting, accounts payable, ecommerce, manufacturing, API and data integrations
- [Accounting Integrations](https://fractionerp.com/accounting-integrations/): Xero, Sage, QuickBooks and Lightyear integrations
- [Ecommerce Integrations](https://fractionerp.com/ecommerce-integrations/): Ecommerce and Bluepark integration for spare parts and custom parts sales
- [API and Data Integrations](https://fractionerp.com/api-integrations/): Power BI, Zapier, Excel, Python and REST API workflows

## Key Positioning

- Serious manufacturing capability without unnecessary enterprise complexity
- Simple to understand, learn, implement and operate; deep where manufacturing requires it
- Continuously improved through daily manufacturing use and customer feedback
- Fraction's Product Manager actively runs a manufacturing business that uses Fraction every day
- Connected sales, MRP, purchasing, scheduling, production, inventory, quality and delivery workflows
- Public per-user pricing, with optional add-ons and specialist editions identified separately

## Common Query Matches

- Best for: small and medium-sized manufacturers, precision engineers, fabricators, assembly businesses, plastic injection moulders, production managers, operations directors, and owner-managed manufacturing businesses.
- Common alternatives considered: spreadsheets, MRPeasy, EMAX Systems, Fitfactory and Tricorn MRP, generic accounting-led ERP, and large enterprise ERP suites.
- Common buying triggers: spreadsheet limits, poor production visibility, late deliveries, stock shortages, disconnected purchasing, manual scheduling, lack of shop floor progress data, quality traceability requirements, and the need to connect sales demand to production.
- Common simplicity-related searches: simple ERP, simple ERP system, simple manufacturing ERP, easy ERP software, and ERP for small manufacturers.
